principles: Honor the B-5a9a invariant: the whole-tree-drift re-attestation advisory must be visible to the operator at DONE.
Surface, do not block: a downgrade-accepted verdict is valid by design; show the advisory, keep the row passing.
Consume, do not re-derive: read the already-recorded escalation.advisories; do not touch the downgrade/freshness logic.
Put it where it is actually rendered: PASS rows print detail, not hint, so the advisory goes in detail.
Minimal blast radius: done-oracle render + one smoke; non-drift output byte-identical.
drivers: A silent-accept at the DONE gate defeats B-5a9a own mandatory-advisory guarantee (Codex host-2 finding, 2026-06-20).
renderDoneChecklist skips hints on pass rows, so the existing hint-only wiring can never show the advisory on a passing DONE.
Blocking on the advisory would re-introduce the instant-reject churn B-5a9a deliberately removed.

options.name: advisory-in-detail-on-pass
pros: Visible on a passing DONE (detail is always printed).
Tiny, consume-only change; no logic touched.
cons: Two render surfaces to keep aligned (done-oracle detail + the success output) — mitigated by the smoke.

options.name: render-hint-on-pass-rows
cons: Changes renderDoneChecklist global pass-row behavior — wider blast radius, risks noisy hints on every pass row.

options.name: block-DONE-on-advisory
cons: Re-introduces the churn B-5a9a removed; contradicts the valid-with-advisory design; over-correction.

rationale: renderDoneChecklist only prints detail on pass rows, so appending escalation.advisories to the Review-escalation row detail when escalation.ok is the smallest change that makes the mandatory advisory visible on a passing DONE without blocking, without touching the sound downgrade logic, and without changing global pass-row rendering.

preMortem.scenario: Advisory put in hint again -> still invisible on pass rows.
preMortem.trigger: Editing the hint instead of detail.
preMortem.consequence: The fix appears done but the advisory is still dropped on pass.
preMortem.mitigation: Put it in DETAIL; the smoke asserts the rendered DONE checklist string CONTAINS the advisory text on a downgrade-accepted pass.

preMortem.scenario: Advisory shown even when there is no drift -> noisy/false alarm.
preMortem.consequence: Operators see a re-attestation advisory on clean DONEs and learn to ignore it.
preMortem.mitigation: Only append when escalation.advisories?.length; the smoke control asserts NO advisory text on a no-drift DONE.

preMortem.scenario: Change accidentally flips the row to fail or blocks DONE.
preMortem.trigger: Touching status/blocking while editing the row.
preMortem.consequence: Clean downgrade-accepted DONEs are blocked — the churn B-5a9a removed returns.
preMortem.mitigation: Leave status=escalation.ok?pass:fail and blocking unchanged; the smoke asserts the row is PASS and DONE still completes.

preMortem.scenario: A second surface (machine.ts guard or another consumer) still swallows it, leaving a silent path.
preMortem.trigger: Assuming done-oracle is the only operator-visible surface.
preMortem.consequence: Some DONE flows still hide the advisory.
preMortem.mitigation: Confirm renderDoneChecklist is the operator-visible DONE surface; verify machine.ts only returns a failure reason (no pass-path render needed); document the finding in review.
